selectedMeasuredSource:
rem Prime Pair Sets
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=60
rem Minimum sum of five primes whose
rem pairwise concatenations are prime
use sequences
use bits
use io
Seed = 10000 build
Upper = Seed 5 50000 min_clique
if Upper equal 50000
  raise "no five-prime set in seed"
end
rem Every prime in a cheaper set is
rem below the discovered upper bound.
Full = Upper build
Answer = Full 5 Upper min_clique
Answer print

rem Row i stores only larger neighbors:
rem bit j means Vals i pairs with Vals j.
rem Group modulo 3, then test both orders.
fun Limit build
  Vals = primes from 3 till Limit filter not equal 5 array
  Scales = array shape (Vals len) fill 10
  Scale = 10
  for P i in Vals
    for Scale at most P
      Scale *= 10
    end
    Scales i = Scale
  end
  Id = 0 till (Vals len) array
  Bits = 2 ** Id
  Rows = array shape (Vals len) fill 0
  if 3 in Vals
    Row = 0
    for Q i in Vals drop 1
      if 3 compatible Q
        Row += Bits (i + 1)
      end
    end
    Rows 0 = Row
  end
  for Residue in 1 to 2
    Positions = Id (Vals mod 3 equal Residue)
    Group = Vals Positions
    Factors = Scales Positions
    GroupBits = Bits Positions
    for P i in Group
      Later = Group drop (i + 1) copy
      Powers = Factors drop (i + 1) copy
      LaterBits = GroupBits drop (i + 1) copy
      Forward' = P * Powers + Later
      Mask = Forward in primes
      Candidates = Later Mask copy
      CandidateBits = LaterBits Mask copy
      Backward' = Candidates * (Factors i) + P
      Good = CandidateBits (Backward in primes) copy
      Rows (Positions i) = Good sum
    end
  end
  return record
    .primes = Vals
    .rows = Rows
  end
end

rem For positive Size, keep Best unless
rem a cheaper clique exists. Values are
rem ascending; band intersects candidates.
fun Data Size Best min_clique
  Vals = Data .primes
  Rows = Data .rows
  Rest = (2 ** (Vals len)) - 1
  return Rest Size 0 Best search

  fun Rest Need Sum Best search
    if Rest popcount less Need
      return Best
    end
    for Rest greater 0
      Mine = Rest band (0 - Rest)
      Rest -= Mine
      At = (Mine - 1) popcount
      P = Vals At
      Total = Sum + P
      if Sum + P * Need at least Best
        break
      end
      Left = Need - 1
      if Left equal 0
        return Total
      end
      Next = Rest band (Rows At)
      Best = Next Left Total Best search
    end
    return Best
  end
end

fun P compatible Q
  PQ = P concat Q
  if PQ not in primes
    return false
  end
  QP = Q concat P
  return QP in primes
end


fun A concat B
  Scale = 10
  for Scale at most B
    Scale *= 10
  end
  return A * Scale + B
end

lazyMeasuredSource:
rem Prime pair sets: demand-driven compatibility
use sequences
use io
Seed = 10000 build
Upper = Seed 5 50000 min_sum
if Upper equal 50000
  raise "no five-prime set in seed"
end
Full = Upper build
Answer = Full 5 Upper min_sum
Answer print

fun Limit build
  Vals = primes from 3 till Limit filter not equal 5 array
  Scales = array shape (Vals len) fill 10
  Scale = 10
  for P i in Vals
    for Scale at most P
      Scale *= 10
    end
    Scales i = Scale
  end
  return record
    .primes = Vals
    .scales = Scales
  end
end

fun Data Need Best min_sum
  Vals = Data .primes
  Scales = Data .scales
  Id = 0 till (Vals len) array
  return Id Need 0 Best search

  fun Rest Need Sum Best search
    if Rest len less Need
      return Best
    end
    Small = Vals (Rest take Need)
    if Sum + Small sum at least Best
      return Best
    end
    for At i in Rest
      P = Vals At
      Total = Sum + P
      if Sum + P * Need at least Best
        break
      end
      Left = Need - 1
      if Left equal 0
        return Total
      end
      Later = Rest drop (i + 1) copy
      if P not equal 3
        Qs = Vals Later
        Later = Later (Qs mod 3 equal (P mod 3)) copy
      end
      Qs = Vals Later
      Forward' = P * (Scales Later) + Qs
      Candidates = Later (Forward in primes) copy
      Backward' = (Vals Candidates) * (Scales At) + P
      Next = Candidates (Backward in primes) copy
      Best = Next Left Total Best search
    end
    return Best
  end
end

fun P compatible Q
  PQ = P concat Q
  if PQ not in primes
    return false
  end
  QP = Q concat P
  return QP in primes
end


fun A concat B
  Scale = 10
  for Scale at most B
    Scale *= 10
  end
  return A * Scale + B
end
